evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic reframe supplies the controlling logic — equating an unrehearsed rollback with no rollback — to persuade via reasoning rather than rank.
Bare cadence label asserts an agreed process standard by declaration, invoking the authority of position to set a recurring obligation.
Naming an owner assigns accountability by fiat, exercising positional authority to allocate responsibility.

mints.name: AphoristicEquationAsMandate
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the authority to act being claimed by equating the unrehearsed with the nonexistent, rather than by rank or process?
